SIDEBAR.NEW_CONVERSATION: Start a conversation with a contact
SIDEBAR.NEW_TICKET: Open an internal ticket for another team
SIDEBAR.RESIZE: Drag to resize. Double-click to collapse or expand the sidebar

CONVERSATION.RESOLVE: Close the conversation. It leaves the queue
CONVERSATION.REOPEN: Send the conversation back to the open queue
CONVERSATION.OPEN: Take it out of pending and back to the open queue
CONVERSATION.MORE_STATUS: Snooze for a while or mark as pending
CONVERSATION.CAKTO_TICKET_BADGE: Internal request opened by someone at Cakto for another team

CAKTO_SLA.primeira_resposta: Time left for the first reply to the customer
CAKTO_SLA.resolucao: Time left to resolve the conversation
CAKTO_SLA.estourado: An SLA deadline was missed on this conversation

COMPOSER.SEND: Send the message to the contact
COMPOSER.SEND_NOTE: Save the note. Only the team sees it
COMPOSER.COPILOT: AI copilot: suggests and improves the reply
COMPOSER.TOGGLE_EDITOR_SIZE: Expand or shrink the writing area
COMPOSER.MODE_TOGGLE: Reply goes to the contact. Private note is team only

CONTACT.SECTION_HEADER: Click to open or close. Drag to reorder
